title: Proficiency
description: What you can do at this level, how we know, and what to do next.
internalStandardNote: Thresholds on this page are the platform's own standard. They are not the official {framework} score, and passing here does not guarantee passing the exam.

entry.learnBody: Everyday basics: recognizing words, building simple sentences, and later reading and listening to short texts.
entry.needBody: You can read and recognize hiragana and katakana ({level}).
entry.knowTitle: How we know you learned it
entry.knowBody: Every question you answer is evidence. A skill counts as secure only after you recalled it correctly across several sessions, not when a lesson is finished.
entry.readyBody: When every available skill is secure, you can take a mock assessment with questions you practiced least. It shows what to review before the real exam.

prerequisite.title: Prerequisite: {level}
prerequisite.met: Met: your kana skills show you are ready to start {target}.
prerequisite.unmet: Not yet: keep practicing {level} until most characters are recognized reliably.

competencies.title: Skills for this level
competencies.platformNote: The exam does not test these directly, but they help you actually use the language.
competencies.planned: Content for this skill is not available yet, so it cannot be measured.

readiness.title: Readiness
readiness.examNote: A recommendation based on your evidence, not an official result.

summary.not_ready: Start with the prerequisite and the first skills below.
summary.developing: You are building the skills. Focus on the gaps below.
summary.assessment_ready: Your available skills are secure. Take the mock assessment, and keep reviewing so they last.
summary.certification_ready: Your evidence supports sitting the exam. This is a recommendation, not a guarantee.

reasons.competency_not_retained: Keep reviewing until it is retained: {competency}.
reasons.assessment_failed: The last mock assessment did not meet the platform standard.

assessment.title: Mock assessment
assessment.notOfficial: This is not an official score. It is the platform's own check, scored per section and overall.
assessment.intro: Each section uses the items you have practiced least, with answer feedback only after each question. Do all sections to get a result.
assessment.novel: {novel} of {total} questions were on items you had not practiced before.

disclaimer: No result here means you are fluent, and none guarantees passing the exam.
